title: Wrecked Yellow Mech Boy
description: A stylized male character in black and yellow armored gear stands upright on the left with a bruised face and determined expression. To the right are two dynamic falling poses of the same character, limbs flailing with eyes closed, surrounded by floating yellow coins and mechanical fragments.
prompt: A stylized young male character with messy blonde hair and facial bruises wearing black tactical clothing with heavy yellow mechanical armor and gauntlets. He has a tough expression in a standing pose on the left. On the right, two separate falling impact poses show him upside down and sprawled with eyes closed, yellow coins and mechanical debris exploding around him, dark background, clean 3D character render style
